item.title: ‘The Greatest Showman’ Musical Sets London’s West End Premiere for 2027
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news from the world of entertainment. And today, we've got some exciting news for musical theater fans. The hit film 'The Greatest Showman' is coming to London's West End!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Disney Theatrical Group announced that the stage adaptation will open at the Theatre Royal Drury Lane in spring 2027. This follows a sold-out world premiere run at the Bristol Hippodrome earlier this year. The news was revealed during the D23 Disney fan event in Anaheim, California."
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, who can we expect to see on stage? Oliver Tompsett will play the lead role of P.T. Barnum, alongside Samantha Barks as his wife, Charity. The cast also includes Ben Joyce, Vajèn van den Bosch, and Malinda Parris. And, of course, the musical will feature the film's signature songs, including 'The Greatest Show', 'A Million Dreams', and 'This Is Me'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The original film, starring Hugh Jackman, was a huge success, with its soundtrack spending two weeks at number one on the Billboard 200 chart in 2018. The movie's song 'This Is Me' even won a Golden Globe for best original song. And, for the stage production, the original songwriters, Benj Pasek and Justin Paul, will return to write the score, with Tim Federle penning the book and Casey Nicholaw directing and choreographing."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, mark your calendars for spring 2027 and get ready to experience the magic of 'The Greatest Showman' on stage in London's West End. Thanks for listening, and we'll see you next time!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
